email.body1:
Chris, saw ServiceTrade signed partnerships with Strategies Group and Pine Services and swept Capterra's 2026 ease-of-use honors.

New partner channels and analyst wins usually open more in-market accounts than the team can personally cover, and that whitespace cools fast. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for ServiceTrade off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Chris, quick follow-up for ServiceTrade.

When channels and awards drive demand, it jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to convert it, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings ServiceTrade needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Chris, last bit of proof for ServiceTrade.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ServiceTrade's reply rate likely compares to other field-service software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Chris, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up new partner channels is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to ServiceTrade either way.
